description: The seven grass/fern/reed species world/sources/flora/groundcover.json binds to painted ground (T3 runtime ring, module 65 §110). Kept separate from flora-province-v1 so the ring renderer loads a few hundred KB, not the 12 MB tree kit, before the ground can dress. No LOD chain: these are 50–500-triangle alpha cards drawn only inside a ~75 m ring, so decimation would only shred the cutouts. Textures capped at 256 px like the flora kit (ships to GitHub Pages).
